blocks.content: Welcome to Chapter 10! In this chapter, we will explore classic Sanskrit literature. Our special Reverse Translation Filter will help you understand every difficult word in English!

blocks.title: Passage 1: Introduction
blocks.content: This beautiful piece of Sanskrit literature teaches us important life values. `` `(These values are universal. / ये मूल्य सार्वभौमिक हैं।)` ``

content.question: What is the main theme of this passage?
content.explanation: Classical literature mostly focuses on human values, devotion, and nature.

blocks.content: 📝 **Board Exam Tip:** Focus on the moral of the story/poem. Questions usually ask you to explain the underlying message in your own words.
